narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Sixteen can sit in the middle of the row, with a card on each side.
<bookmark mark='slots'/>A middle card needs two partners, but sixteen has only nine.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A card with one partner must stand at an end of the row.

<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Arrange one, three, six and eight so neighbours add to squares.
